$comment: MIMI Lite: the quick start. One small model that chats, sees and speaks; the practical references (medicine, repair, survival, travel, the most-read Wikipedia articles); a world overview map plus a detailed map of one region. About 15 GB plus the region's map (0.2-8 GB, see manifests/regions.json). Runs on 8 GB of RAM. Packs are defined in manifests/packs.json; add more any time with scripts/content.py add <pack>.
title: Lite
